days.file: Duccio di Buoninsegna - Calling of Peter and Andrew - WGA06774.jpg
days.title: The Calling of Peter and Andrew
days.alt: Jesus stands on the shore and gestures toward two fishermen, one in blue and one in red, sitting side by side in a boat.
days.look: Look again at the two brothers side by side in the boat. Who has stood beside you when you could not manage alone?
days.license: Artist died c. 1319; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Joan de Joanes - The Last Supper - WGA12058.jpg
days.title: The Last Supper
days.alt: Jesus holds up the bread at the centre of a long table while his apostles lean toward him on both sides.
days.look: Look again at Jesus, with his friends gathered close. What does it mean to you that he calls you a friend?
days.license: Artist died 1579; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Visitation
days.alt: Mary and her older cousin Elizabeth hold each other’s arms and look into each other’s faces.
days.look: Look again at Mary and Elizabeth, face to face. Who has been a shelter for you, and have you told them?
days.license: Artist died 1494; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Venant, François - The parting of David and Jonathan - Fondation Custodia.jpg
days.title: The Parting of David and Jonathan
days.alt: A young man in a plumed helmet kneels and clasps the hand of a standing man in a white turban.
days.look: Look again at David and Jonathan, face to face. Who helps you turn back toward God?
days.license: Artist died 1672; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Annibale Carracci - Christ and the Samaritan Woman - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Christ and the Samaritan Woman
days.alt: Jesus sits at a well and speaks to a woman who has come to draw water.
days.look: Look again at Jesus, who speaks first to a stranger. Who could you greet first this week?
days.license: Artist died 1609; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Supper at Emmaus
days.alt: Jesus breaks bread at a small table while two companions watch him in the dim light.
days.look: Look again at the hands breaking the bread. Where do you find a table you could share?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Codex Aureus - Healing Of The Paralytic.jpg
days.title: Christ Healing the Paralytic
days.alt: Four men lower a man on a mat through the roof to Jesus, while a crowd looks on.
days.look: Look again at the mat lowered through the roof. Whom could you carry to Jesus today?
days.license: Manuscript c. 980–993, artist unknown; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: 0134Hb. Saints Basil the Great, John Chrysostom, and Gregory the Theologian.jpg
days.title: Saints Basil the Great, John Chrysostom and Gregory the Theologian
days.place: Museum of Christian Culture, St. Petersburg
days.alt: St. Basil and St. Gregory stand on either side of St. John Chrysostom, in bishops’ vestments, with books in their hands.
days.look: Look again at the saints standing close together. Is there an old hurt you could bring to God today?
days.license: Icon, artist unknown, 19th century; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: El Greco - Saint Peter and Saint Paul - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Saint Peter and Saint Paul
days.alt: Peter, white-bearded, and Paul, holding a sword, stand close with their hands nearly touching.
days.look: Look again at Peter and Paul standing together. For which friend do you want to give thanks today?
days.license: Artist died 1614; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
